## IndexQueryValue type

Value type of a single index key inside [IIndexQuery](./lmdb.iindexquery.md)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IndexQueryValue<T, P extends string, D = unknown> = P extends keyof T ? T[P] : D extends {
    composite: readonly [string, ...string[]];
} ? ILmdbKey | ICompositeRange : ILmdbKey;
```
**References:** [ILmdbKey](./lmdb.ilmdbkey.md)<!-- -->, [ICompositeRange](./lmdb.icompositerange.md)

## Remarks

Resolves to the indexed field's type when the index name is an auto-resolved field path on `T` (`username` → `T["username"]`<!-- -->); otherwise falls back to [ILmdbKey](./lmdb.ilmdbkey.md) (explicit extractors may index arbitrary key-shaped values).
